name: Shinozaki Seiichi
source:
The protagonist of this work, Miyamae Haruna's childhood friend and first lover.

He is reasonably cheerful with a strong sense of justice and responsibility. However, due to his parents divorce, he has some trauma regarding women after discovering that his mother was a slut, who cheated on his father, Seiichi starts believing that all girls are manipulative and just want to play with boys for their own amusement.

Influenced by his childhood friend Miyamae Haruna, who tends to keep her distance from girls, he aims to turn over a new leaf and overcome his trauma.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc044/character.html]the official site[/url]]
